title: Local presheaf maps are stable under braided tensor
statement:
Fix a universe $\mathcal V$. Let $(C,J)$ be a $\mathcal V$-small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a category with $\mathcal V$-small Hom sets and all $\mathcal V$-small limits, equipped with a monoidal structure [def-sfb-monoidal-category] which is closed (each $M\otimes-$ has a right adjoint) and braided (natural isomorphisms $M\otimes N\cong N\otimes M$ satisfying both hexagon identities). Give $\mathrm{PSh}=\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$ its pointwise tensor $\otimes_p$.

For a presheaf $H$, being a sheaf means that $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(T,H(-))$ is a sheaf of sets for every $T\in\mathcal A$. Define $W$ to consist of presheaf maps $f:P\to Q$ such that precomposition $\operatorname{Nat}(Q,H)\to\operatorname{Nat}(P,H)$ is bijective for every sheaf $H$.

The class $W$ contains identities, is closed under composition, and is stable under tensoring on either side: if $f\in W$ and $R$ is any presheaf, then $\mathrm{id}_R\otimes_p f\in W$ and $f\otimes_p\mathrm{id}_R\in W$.
